words.trans: n. 困惑、茫然不解；哭笑不得的状态（in bemusement 茫然地）
examples: She stood back and looked at him, shaking her head in bemusement.

words.trans: 固定短语：突然哈哈大笑；拓展 burst out + doing 突然做……，burst into + 名词（burst into laughter）同义
examples: They both burst out laughing at the amount of water that had transferred to her dress.

words.trans: adj. 滴水的、湿漉漉的；v.（drip 现在分词）往下滴水
examples: Ten minutes later, Tom's clothes were still dripping on to the kitchen floor.

words.trans: n.（英国）警员，最低一级的正式警察（穿制服的普通巡警，缩写 PC）
examples: Jim arrived with PC Clark, who had shown him into the pickup truck.

words.trans: 短语：暗语、代码词、暗号（此处是警方无线电用语）
examples: She listened with wide eyes and called some code words and a location into her radio.

words.trans: v. & n. 隆隆作响、低沉轰鸣（雷/引擎/远处动静）
examples: There was a rumble overhead as the Puma helicopter appeared.

words.trans: 短语：及时赶到、结果正好能做某事；just in time 更常见，just 加强"刚好险些来不及"
examples: They rushed to the harbour in time to see an orange flash as the Invincible rocketed past.

words.trans: v. 费力攀爬、艰难往上爬（手脚并用）
examples: Heavily armed soldiers clambered down ladders on to the boat.

words.trans: adj. ①（草木）繁茂葱郁（lush forest）；②（毛发）浓密丰厚（文中形容头发）
examples: There was no mistaking Dr Victoria Juniper's lush red hair.

words.trans: v. 吊起、抬升；（此处）押送带走（was hoisted at gunpoint 在枪口威胁下被押上直升机）
examples: She was hoisted at gunpoint into the bowels of the helicopter.

words.trans: n. 复数，（建筑物、大型交通工具的）内部深处（熟词僻义，不只是"肠子"）；the bowels of the ship 船舱深处
examples: They were hoisted into the bowels of the helicopter.

words.trans: adj. 无所畏惧的、勇敢的（daunt 使退缩 + -less）
examples: He woke to hear Maggie's voice, as fresh and dauntless as ever.

words.trans: 短语：放洗澡水（往浴缸放水备好一缸热水；美式一般说 draw a bath）
examples: Aunt Emily had run a bath at last.

words.trans: 固定短语：给他补充能量、撑住体力，让他能继续坚持下去
examples: Aunt Emily brought him brownies and milk 'to keep him going'.

words.trans: 短语：侧耳听见、开始留意听（tune into 原指收音机调台接收信号，比喻留意倾听）
examples: While he dressed he tuned into the conversation below.

words.trans: 固定习语：猛地惊醒（start 此处名词：突然一惊，不是"开始"）
examples: He woke with a start, the milk and brownies still by the bath.

words.trans: v. 踉跄、摇摇晃晃地走（累/虚弱/醉）
examples: You should have seen him when he staggered into the kitchen.

words.trans: 英语习语：落汤鸡（字面"淹死的老鼠"，形容浑身湿透的人）
examples: He looked like a drowned rat.

words.trans: n. 暴徒、恶棍
examples: Letting Thomas get taken off like that by those thugs at the police station.

words.trans: 短语：被带走、被带走离开（被动，被警察/某人带走）
examples: She felt stupid letting Thomas get taken off like that.

words.trans: 固定短语：不管怎样、想方设法、无论用什么办法
examples: They were going to get me one way or another.

words.trans: 习语：可不是嘛！说得太对了！（感叹降调=赞同；区别于 Can you say that again? 升调=请重复一遍）
examples: 'You can say that again, Tom,' said Joel.

words.trans: 习语：（人）轰然倒下、昏倒；（船）倾覆
examples: You should have seen him keel over when Tom shot him with the darts.

words.trans: 短语：有一堆信息/故事等着互相讲（各自经历要分享补齐）
examples: I can see you three have a bit of catching up to do.

words.trans: n.【医学】丙泊酚（短效麻醉药物）
examples: We've spoken to Dad about the propofol.

words.trans: 名词短语：三倍剂量（triple 三倍 + dose 剂量）
examples: You gave him a triple dose, so he was like Sleeping Beauty.

words.trans: n.（药物的）一剂、剂量
examples: You gave him a triple dose.

words.trans: 固定句型：做某事需要付出（代价/手段）；that's what it takes 这就是做成这件事所需的代价
examples: He said, 'If that's what it took to save my daughter's life, I won't be complaining.'

words.trans: 固定虚拟表达：要不是……、若非有……（虚拟语气）
examples: But if it weren't for you two, I wouldn't be here now.

words.trans: v. 丧生、灭亡、毁灭（正式/新闻常用，火灾遇难）
examples: The news report says the owner perished with the farm.

words.trans: n. 引水渠、高架输水管道（Thirlmere Aqueduct 输水隧道）
examples: He will have carried on in the aqueduct to come out somewhere else.

words.trans: n. 审问、审讯（interrogate 的名词）
examples: Right at the end of his interrogation, I saw he had a tiny submarine.

words.trans: 英式口语习语：逃之夭夭、溜之大吉（字面看不出逃跑含义；逃避买单/责任/追捕）
examples: I saw him take it out of the cupboard and do a runner.

words.trans: 短语：碰运气、冒险赌一把、听天由命试一试（明知危险成败难料还是去做）
examples: While the others took their chances in the river, he went through the aqueduct.

words.trans: v. 继续、接着进行、持续下去
examples: He carried on in the aqueduct to come out somewhere else.

words.trans: n. 此处不是普通"采访"，而是（警方、情报机构的）问询、正式问话笔录
examples: The next day the interviews began.

words.trans: 短语：陈述、描述某事经过（account 此处=口头/书面的描述，多用于官方问询、目击证词；give an account of what happened 陈述经过）
examples: They had given detailed accounts of everything they knew.

words.trans: v. 定罪、宣判有罪（convict 的过去分词；be convicted 被定罪）
examples: None of it would be enough to get the gang members convicted and locked up.

words.trans: 短语：有价值、值得关注、有参考意义（≠好玩有趣）。调查/法律语境潜台词：有用，但还不够决定性证据。书面正式句式
examples: The photos were of interest but would only link Clay himself.

words.trans: adj. 确凿的、决定性的、一锤定音的（conclusive evidence 铁证）
examples: The photos were far from conclusive.

words.trans: adj. 邪恶的、凶险的、暗藏歹意的、有阴谋的
examples: Official records pointed to nothing more sinister than an ice cream factory.

words.trans: 固定短语：宣誓保密、被要求发誓保守秘密（sworn 宣誓过的 + secrecy 保密）
examples: They had been sworn to secrecy until further notice.

words.trans: adj. 失足的、有过失的、违法违纪的（a delinquent boy 问题少年）
examples: A delinquent boy who tried to ram the Queen's boat.

words.trans: v. 猛撞、撞击、冲撞（交通工具高速撞向）
examples: A delinquent boy who tried to ram the Queen's boat.

words.trans: adj.【英式口语】令人极度失望的、让人泄气的（熟词僻义；gut 摧毁内部，gutting 让人内心受挫）
examples: 'Totally gutting,' Maggie said.

words.trans: 介词短语：恼怒地、万分恼火地（exasperation 恼怒）
examples: 'Totally gutting,' Maggie said in exasperation.

words.trans: v. 传唤、召来（传唤某人到场；summons 传票）
examples: Tom had been summoned back to the interview room alone.

words.trans: v. 准许离开、释放、放行（wait to be discharged 等候办手续离开）
examples: He was told to wait to be discharged.

words.trans: v. 紧紧抓住、攥紧、抱紧（n. 另见 36 章"离合器"）
examples: He was expecting PC Clark to walk in clutching some forms.

words.trans: 名词短语：飞行员款墨镜、蛤蟆镜（aviator 飞行员）
examples: A black man with aviator-style sunglasses came in.

words.trans: n.（空军）中队；Squadron Leader（英军 RAF 军衔）空军中队长
examples: He introduced himself as Squadron Leader Richard Riley.

words.trans: adv. 专心地、凝神地、目不转睛地
examples: Squadron Leader Riley listened intently, eyes fixed on Tom.

words.trans: （航空/飞行器语境）= 击落、使坠毁（bring down a plane 把飞机打下来）
examples: They discovered the plot to bring down the Red Arrows.

words.trans: v.【正式】借调、抽调（人员去另一岗位；熟词僻义，读 /sɪˈkɒnd/，非"第二"）
examples: I was seconded to the Signals for a while.

words.trans: 短语：省去麻烦、省事
examples: I would have saved a whole lot of trouble.

words.trans: 名词短语：固定翼（普通飞机，相对直升机旋翼）
examples: He taught me to fly fixed wings.

words.trans: n. rotary-wing 旋翼（直升机）；transfer to rotary 转飞旋翼机
examples: Before I transferred to rotary, I flew fixed wings.

words.trans: 固定动作描写：鼓起腮帮子（表示震惊、惊叹、松了一口气）
examples: He leant back and puffed out his cheeks in amazement.
